summary: SMI should combine the strongest useful AI capability patterns into an OAP-owned intelligence fabric without copying provider branding, private prompts, product identity or model internals. SMI remains the brain and external providers, when used, remain replaceable tools/advisors with no authority.

Current AI ecosystem research supports these useful patterns for OAP: adaptive/agentic coding with review and advisor passes; million-token-class long-context synthesis and multimodal tool use; real-time web-grounded retrieval with citations; efficient thinking/non-thinking routing; live web/social signal retrieval; structured tool orchestration and context compaction. Treat these as capability references, not claims that one provider is universally best.

OAP Intelligence Fabric capability set should include adaptive 3/7/21 reasoning, agentic code review, advisor/challenger review, long-context synthesis, multimodal fusion, cited live research, parallel retrieval, live signal awareness, cost-aware routing, tool orchestration, structured output, context compaction, evidence-first verification, local-first failover and safe process telemetry.
